nodes.title: Number sense and operations
nodes.summary: Arithmetic, fractions, decimals, percentages, ratios and proportional reasoning.

nodes.title: Algebra and equations
nodes.summary: Variables, expressions, equality, equations, inequalities and symbolic manipulation.

nodes.title: Geometry and spatial reasoning
nodes.summary: Shape, measurement, spatial relationships, coordinate geometry and proof foundations.

nodes.title: Data, statistics and probability
nodes.summary: Data literacy, descriptive statistics, uncertainty and probability.

nodes.title: Mathematical and scientific reasoning
nodes.summary: Logic, modelling, evidence, hypotheses, measurement and scientific inference.

nodes.title: Physics foundations
nodes.summary: Physical quantities, motion, forces, energy, waves, electricity and mathematical models of physical systems.

nodes.title: Chemistry foundations
nodes.summary: Matter, atomic models, chemical bonding, reactions, quantities and transformations.

nodes.title: Human anatomy
nodes.summary: Structures of the human body and their spatial and functional organisation.

nodes.title: Human physiology
nodes.summary: How body systems function and regulate internal conditions.

nodes.title: Source evaluation and evidence
nodes.summary: Source provenance, reliability, evidence quality and corroboration.

nodes.title: Learning systems and metacognition
nodes.summary: Planning, retrieval, practice, feedback, reflection and self-regulated learning.

nodes.title: Explanation and structured communication
nodes.summary: Clear explanations, definitions, examples, argument structure and audience adaptation.

nodes.title: Computational foundations
nodes.summary: Algorithms, data representation, decomposition and computational problem-solving.

nodes.title: Electrical foundations
nodes.summary: Charge, current, voltage, resistance, energy and elementary circuit models.

nodes.title: Fraction as a number and ratio
nodes.summary: A fraction represents a quantity formed by dividing a whole into equal parts and can also express a ratio.

nodes.title: Proportional relationship
nodes.summary: A relationship in which two quantities change by a constant multiplicative factor.

nodes.title: Variable as a quantity
nodes.summary: A symbol representing a quantity whose value may be unknown or vary.

nodes.title: Equality and equivalent expressions
nodes.summary: An equation asserts that two expressions have the same value; valid transformations preserve equality.

nodes.title: Inverse operations
nodes.summary: Operations that undo one another under specified conditions.

nodes.title: Solve and explain a one-variable linear equation
nodes.summary: Independently solve unfamiliar one-variable linear equations, justify each equality-preserving step and check the solution.

nodes.title: Testable hypothesis
nodes.summary: A proposed explanation or prediction that can be examined through observation or experiment.

nodes.title: Independent, dependent and controlled variables
nodes.summary: Distinguish the variable deliberately changed, the outcome measured and factors held consistent.

nodes.title: Evaluate a claim against evidence
nodes.summary: Identify a claim, inspect relevant evidence, assess source quality and explain whether the evidence supports the claim.

nodes.title: Structure-function relationship
nodes.summary: Biological structures have properties that enable, constrain or regulate their functions.

nodes.title: Homeostasis
nodes.summary: Regulation of internal conditions within viable ranges through interacting control mechanisms.

nodes.title: Use retrieval practice effectively
nodes.summary: Recall and explain learned material without looking, check accuracy, correct errors and schedule later retrieval.

nodes.title: Explain a concept clearly
nodes.summary: Give an accurate explanation using a definition, mechanism, example and appropriate level of detail.

nodes.title: Algorithm
nodes.summary: A finite, sufficiently precise procedure for transforming inputs into outputs or solving a class of problems.

nodes.title: Ohm's law
nodes.summary: For an ohmic conductor under specified physical conditions, voltage, current and resistance are related by V = IR.
